purpose: Record which methodological lessons from the completed partial-transport mobilization-runway study are inherited by the partner-force autonomy program, without importing its fitted coefficients or substantive claim.

source_result.key_transport_observation: A realized state-flow runway coordinate transported across mechanism shifts better than a crude static parameter proxy, especially when logistics burden changed.
source_result.important_failure: Absolute probability calibration compressed out of distribution even while discrimination remained useful.

inherit.rule: Prefer realized state and flow measurements over nominal parameter settings when predicting post-support behavior.
inherit.partner_force_implication: Do not infer autonomy from force size, training multipliers, donor settings, or headline supported performance alone.

inherit.rule: Freeze candidate coordinates, transformations, outcome definitions, and success gates before held-out mechanism tests.
inherit.partner_force_implication: Autonomy predictors must be frozen before withdrawal-architecture holdouts and before any historical Afghanistan diagnostic.

inherit.rule: Use zero-refit transport across unseen mechanism families as the main test of whether a synthetic relation is structural rather than interpolation-specific.
inherit.partner_force_implication: A predictor discovered under one assistance architecture must be evaluated unchanged under distinct support compositions, complexity burdens, and force-generation regimes.
A high AUC does not license a universal probability law; calibration slopes and Brier scores remain independent gates.

inherit.rule: Use physical accounting identities to motivate coordinates, but do not assume their functional form is universal.
inherit.partner_force_implication: Candidate regenerative-runway and bottleneck coordinates should be derived from measured stocks/flows, then compared against arithmetic-mean, minimum, geometric-mean, and interaction alternatives.

do_not_inherit: The fitted Omega_K logistic intercept or slope.
The 60-120 day observation window as a universal partner-force window.
Capital exhaustion as a proxy for partner-force collapse.
Any claim that the mobilization runway relation is a real-world conflict law.

new_candidate_family.name: regenerative runway
new_candidate_family.concept: For an indigenous subsystem j, compare the stock or service buffer available at withdrawal with its endogenous post-withdrawal net depletion/recovery timescale.
new_candidate_family.generic_form: Omega_j = tau_j / h, with tau_j derived from observed indigenous stock and endogenous net flow; exact subsystem definitions must be source-audited before implementation.
new_candidate_family.warning: The partner-force experiment must estimate these from partner-owned state/flows only. Externally supplied flows must be separately metered so support does not masquerade as endogenous regeneration.

compute_policy.reason: The prior battery was cancelled for compute contention. This bridge is a design artifact only.
compute_policy.next_compute_gate: Do not launch partner-force runs until source audit, support-overlay design, paired-branch determinism checks, and outcome assay are frozen.
